# RAIS custom elements

Framework-free web components for the RAIS component library (v1.1.0), built with Angular Elements (Angular 19.2.19). Every component in `src/components/*` is registered as a custom element under its selector. Generated by `npm run build:elements` — do not edit by hand.

## Quick start

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="rais-elements.css">
<script>window.RAIS_ASSET_BASE = './assets/'; // optional, this is the default</script>
<script src="rais-elements.js"></script>

<rais-button label="Save"></rais-button>
```

Load the stylesheet before the script (both in `<head>` is simplest). The script can go anywhere: it defines the
elements once the page has been parsed. See `demo.html` for every element with sample data.

| File | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `rais-elements.js` | zone.js, the Angular runtime and every component in one classic script (no chunks) |
| `rais-elements.css` | Figtree font import, PrimeNG Aura theme tokens, RAIS design tokens (`src/index.css`) and all component styles |
| `assets/` | icons and images used by the components (copy of `public/assets`) |
| `demo.html` | every element with sample data, property and event examples |
| `3rdpartylicenses.txt` | licenses of the bundled third-party code |

## Setting inputs

Every `@Input()` is both an **attribute** (kebab-case: `icon-pos`) and a **property** (camelCase: `iconPos`).
Properties take any value; use them for arrays and objects. Attributes are strings, converted to the input's type:

| Input type | Attribute value |
| --- | --- |
| `string` (and string unions) | as written |
| `boolean` | `""` (attribute present) or `"true"` → `true`; `"false"` → `false` |
| `number` | parsed as a number (invalid values fall back to the default, with a console warning) |
| arrays / objects | JSON, e.g. `options='["Day","Week"]'` (invalid JSON falls back to the default) |
| `string \| false` | `"false"` → `false`, anything else is the string |

Removing an attribute restores the input's default. Properties set on an element before `rais-elements.js` has
loaded are applied when the element upgrades.

```js
const column = document.querySelector('rais-table-column');
column.cellValues = ['06/09/2026', '06/10/2026'];
```

**`style` inputs.** `rais-accordion-link` and `rais-selection-label` have an input named `style`, which is also the
native inline-style attribute/property. On these elements the native `el.style` keeps working; set the input with the
`style-variant` attribute or the `styleVariant` property. `style="plus"` (a valid keyword) also works as in the Angular
templates; any other `style` value is treated as inline CSS.

## Events

Each `@Output()` dispatches a `CustomEvent` on the element, named exactly like the output (case-sensitive),
with the emitted value in `event.detail` (`null` for outputs that emit nothing, typed `void`). These events do
not bubble — listen on the element itself.
Native events from inside an element (`click`, `input`, `change`, …) bubble as usual: `rais-button` has no
outputs, so listen for `click`.

```js
document.querySelector('rais-button-tab-set')
  .addEventListener('selectionChange', (event) => console.log(event.detail));
```

## Assets

Icons and images are loaded from `window.RAIS_ASSET_BASE` (read once when the script runs; default `./assets/`,
resolved against the page URL). It applies both to `<img>` icons and to icons drawn with CSS masks. Copy the
`assets/` folder next to the bundle, or point the variable at wherever it is hosted:

```html
<script>window.RAIS_ASSET_BASE = 'https://cdn.example.com/rais/assets/';</script>
```

If the assets are on another origin, serve them with an `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` header: browsers fetch
CSS mask images (close buttons, sort arrows, navigation icons) in CORS mode, so without it those icons stay blank.

## Runtime

- `customElements.whenDefined('rais-button')` or `await RaisElements.ready` waits until the elements are defined.
- `window.RaisElements` → `{ version, tags, ready, assetBase, styles }`. `styles` is `"stylesheet"` when
  `rais-elements.css` from the same build was found, or `"injected"` when it was missing (the bundle then injects
  the component styles itself and logs a warning — design tokens, fonts and the PrimeNG theme still need the CSS).
- Always deploy `rais-elements.js` and `rais-elements.css` from the same build.
- zone.js is bundled. If the page already loaded zone.js (e.g. another Angular app), that instance is reused.

## Notes

- Composite elements render their children themselves (e.g. `rais-table` → `rais-table-column` → `rais-table-header`
  / `rais-table-cell`, `rais-insured-payments` → header, navigation, tables). Set inputs on the outer element.
- `rais-drawer` projects the child nodes it has when it is attached to the page; nodes added later are not projected.
- `rais-insured-payments` (component selector `insured-payments`) is registered with the `rais-` prefix.
- `rais-elements.css` contains `src/index.css`, so it includes its page-level base styles (`* { box-sizing: border-box }`
  and `body` font/colour/background) and the Figtree `@import` from Google Fonts.
- `<rais-table-column>` has page-wide CSS (a top-level `::ng-deep` in its stylesheet). As in the Angular app, it applies to
  the whole page only while that element is rendered, so it is added by the script rather than kept in `rais-elements.css`.

### `<rais-accordion-link>`

Accordion Link — RAIS Actions component

Source: `src/components/accordion-link/rais-accordion-link.component.ts`.

| Input | Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label | `label` | `label` | `string` | `"Label"` | Link label text. |
| style | `style-variant` (or `style` with a keyword) | `styleVariant` | `"caret" \| "plus"` | `"caret"` | Style — caret (chevron right) or plus (plus/minus left). |
| size | `size` | `size` | `"large" \| "medium" \| "small"` | `"medium"` | Size — drives both font size/weight and icon size. |
| state | `state` | `state` | `"default" \| "hover"` | `"default"` | State — default or hover. |
| open | `open` | `open` | `boolean` | `false` | Expanded vs collapsed — swaps the icon. |

No custom events.
